newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SAUDIS WANT OPEC ROLLOVER, COMMITMENT TO QUOTAS.
newsitem.headline: SAUDIS WANT OPEC ROLLOVER, COMMITMENT TO QUOTAS.

text.p: Saudi Arabia is looking for OPEC to agree on a rollover at this week's conference, but will a commitment to output quotas, a Gulf source said.

The source said Saudi Arabia was looking for "a rollover with a serious commitment to the ceiling....We will try to solicit every possible acquiesence with this reconfirmed commitment. We will make the case that we all could benefit".
The Gulf source said that lower oil prices would oblige those OPEC members who were now exceeding their quotas to think again.
"Those that are overproducing are beginning to feel it now. They have given it their best shot and they got higher prices for a while, but now things are tilting differently.
"We think the ceiling is correct. If we can enforce that ceiling and commit ourselves to it, prices will be higher".
